subject.warning: [Warning] AI budget is nearing its limit

body.warning:
Your AI usage is approaching the budget limit. Please review:
• Today Tokens: {dailyUsed} / {dailyLimit} ({dailyPercent}%)
• This Month Cost: ${monthlyUsed} / ${monthlyLimit} ({monthlyPercent}%)

To avoid service interruption, please adjust your usage or contact the administrator to raise the quota.
body.critical:
Your AI usage has reached the budget limit and may impact subsequent calls:
• Today Tokens: {dailyUsed} / {dailyLimit} ({dailyPercent}%)
• This Month Cost: ${monthlyUsed} / ${monthlyLimit} ({monthlyPercent}%)

Please adjust your usage or contact the administrator immediately to raise the quota, otherwise over-limit usage may be restricted or suspended.
